T: Two girls in the band. Three courses on the train.
D: Two musicians on the run from the mob disguise themselves as women in an all-girl band.
P: Serve the drinks when the girls throw a party in Daphne's sleeper berth on the train.
S: Speakeasy devilled eggs with crispy pancetta
Devilled eggs with a Dijon mayo yolk, crispy pancetta, smoked paprika

Boiled eggs with yolks whipped with mayo, mustard and smoked paprika, piped back in and topped with shards of crispy pancetta and chives. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and halve. Mash the yolks with 80g mayonnaise, 2 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tsp white vinegar, salt and a pinch of smoked paprika until smooth. Pipe or spoon back into the whites. Bake 8 slices of pancetta on a tray at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp, cool and break into shards. Top each egg with pancetta, a dusting of paprika and snipped chives.
Prawns poached in lemon water, chilled in iced water, served on ice
Prawns poached in salted water with lemon, chilled and served on ice with cocktail sauce.
sharp cheddar, roast capsicum, mayo and cayenne on crackers with salami, for Sweet Sue's band

Sharp cheddar beaten with roasted capsicum, mayo and cayenne into a spread, piled on crackers with thin salami and a slice of cornichon. Grate 250g vintage cheddar. Finely chop 100g drained roasted red capsicum. Mix the cheese and capsicum with 100g mayonnaise, 50g soft cream cheese, a pinch of cayenne and a few drops of hot sauce until spreadable. Chill 30 minutes. Spread generously on 32 water crackers, top each with a fold of salami (100g total) and a slice of cornichon, and stack them on a tray.
M: Grilled lobster tails with garlic butter, baby potatoes and green beans
Lobster tails split and grilled with garlic butter for 6 minutes, with buttered baby potatoes, green beans and lemon.
Friends of Italian Opera meatball spaghetti
beef and pork balls with parmesan in tomato basil sugo, piled high, for Spats Colombo

Beef and pork meatballs with parmesan and parsley, browned and simmered in a rich tomato and basil sugo, piled over spaghetti on one big platter. Mix 300g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 50g breadcrumbs soaked in 60ml milk, 1 egg, 40g grated parmesan, 2 tbsp chopped parsley, 1 garlic clove and salt. Roll into 20 balls and brown in olive oil. Remove. Soften 1 onion and 2 garlic cloves, add 1.4kg passata and simmer 10 minutes. Return the meatballs, cover and simmer 30 minutes, adding basil at the end. Cook 500g spaghetti, toss with some sauce and pile onto a platter with the meatballs and more parmesan.
W: Three butter sponge layers with strawberry jam and whipped cream
Vanilla sponge baked in three tins at 175C for 25 minutes, stacked with jam and cream, iced white and topped with candles.
K: Bourbon, sweet vermouth and bitters stirred cold, with a cherry
Bourbon stirred with sweet vermouth and bitters over ice, strained with a cherry. Use a jug, not a hot water bottle.

s.n: Speakeasy devilled eggs with crispy pancetta
s.note: Devilled eggs with a Dijon mayo yolk, crispy pancetta, smoked paprika
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and halve. Mash the yolks with 80g mayonnaise, 2 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tsp white vinegar, salt and a pinch of smoked paprika until smooth. Pipe or spoon back into the whites. Bake 8 slices of pancetta on a tray at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp, cool and break into shards. Top each egg with pancetta, a dusting of paprika and snipped chives.

s.note: Prawns poached in lemon water, chilled in iced water, served on ice
s.how: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil with lemon slices. Add 500g green prawns and poach for 2 minutes, then plunge into iced water. Peel and serve on ice with mayonnaise mixed with tomato sauce, lemon and hot sauce.

m.note: Grilled lobster tails with garlic butter, baby potatoes and green beans
m.how: Split 4 lobster tails and brush with butter mixed with crushed garlic. Grill for 6 minutes until just cooked. Boil 800g baby potatoes and steam green beans, then toss both with butter. Serve with lemon wedges. Well, nobody's perfect.

w.note: Three butter sponge layers with strawberry jam and whipped cream
w.how: Beat 300g butter with 300g sugar, add 5 eggs and fold in 300g self-raising flour. Bake in 3 tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Stack with strawberry jam and whipped cream, ice white and top with candles. Watch who jumps out.

d.note: Bourbon, sweet vermouth and bitters stirred cold, with a cherry
d.how: For each drink, stir 60ml bourbon, 30ml sweet vermouth and 2 dashes aromatic bitters with ice in a jug. Strain into chilled glasses and drop in a maraschino cherry. Use a jug, not a hot water bottle in an upper berth.
